regions.full_page: I hope this finds you in the best of health and hopes. Thanks be to God we are quite well down here in St. Felix. After a cold and wet spring -- even black frost on the 8th the weather has turned quite ideal. Deo Gr. I was certainly pleased to receive a very bright letter from Fr. M. Joachim last week, about the best in a long time. It really looks like his old self once more. Thanks be to God "a billion." I wrote him several weeks ago that I had already permis- sion to go on a trip to Chicago and St. Paul, etc. at my choice and leaving the arrangements to yourself and him. I believe he said he sent you a copy of said letter. Well, .... We expect V. Rev. Fr. Provincial down from Detroit shortly -- just back from Guam and several other islands in the Pacific, and I anticipate no difficulty in obtaining permission to go also to Superior as M. J. proposes. I would be glad to have any suggestions that might heighten interests relative to the proposition. I'll probably get a week or so off for the trip. So I'll be more or less depending on your arrangements for a program, etc. I have not heard just lately from any one in the farther west. Please God it's indicative of smoothe sailing out that way. Thanks be to God and our Bl. Mother Mary and all the Communion of Saints.

regions.full_page: P. S. I believe I owe you a couple letters since January. The trouble is -- too often -- I put letters aside till I can answer them properly and the Ist thing I know they're snowed under and often forgotten. Please pardon.
